details: Bitcoin climbed above $81,000 for the first time since January, propelled by significant ETF inflows totaling $2.44 billion in April, easing US-Iran tensions, and a notable short squeeze. This marks its highest price in three months.
title: Bitcoin Breaks $81,000 Amid ETF Inflows & De-escalation

details: Andreessen Horowitz's (a16z) crypto arm launched its new $2.2 billion Fund 5, with the strategic goal of investing in startups building the next era of financial technology. The fund specifically targets real-world crypto applications, including stablecoins and payments, signaling a shift beyond mere speculation.
title: A16z Crypto Unveils $2.2 Billion Fund for Web3 Innovation

details: Coinbase announced a 14% reduction in its workforce, affecting approximately 700 employees, as part of a restructuring plan. The company attributes this move to AI productivity, prevailing market volatility, and a strong focus on cost discipline.
title: Coinbase Cuts 14% of Workforce, Shifts to 'AI-Native' Strategy

details: Toncoin (TON) experienced a significant 25% price surge after Telegram officially announced its direct takeover of the network. This move includes drastically cutting fees by 6x and implementing various upgrades, which has notably boosted staking and transaction activity.
title: Toncoin Surges 25% as Telegram Takes Direct Control

details: Digital asset investment products recorded a net inflow of $117.8 million, successfully breaking a four-day streak of outflows. Bitcoin was the primary beneficiary, attracting over $192 million in investments, while Ethereum and Solana experienced minor outflows.
title: Digital Asset Funds See $117.8M Inflow, Ending Outflow Streak

details: The Canadian federal government is reportedly planning to implement a ban on crypto ATMs nationwide. This proposed measure is a response to concerns about their significant role in facilitating fraud and money laundering, signaling stricter regulatory oversight and potential limitations on retail access to digital assets.
title: Canada Proposes Ban on Crypto ATMs Amid Fraud Concerns

details: Kelp DAO has migrated its operations from LayerZero to Chainlink's cross-chain infrastructure. This significant move follows a substantial $292 million exploit that impacted LayerZero, underscoring a growing demand for more secure and robust solutions within the DeFi ecosystem.
title: Kelp DAO Ditches LayerZero for Chainlink After $292M Exploit

details: Ledger has integrated Hyperliquid perpetual futures trading directly into its hardware wallets via Yield.xyz. This new feature allows eligible users to securely access leveraged trading, significantly enhancing the security and functionality for derivatives traders.
title: Ledger Hardware Wallets Integrate Hyperliquid Perps Trading
